_comment: English user-facing strings. Mirrors ko.json key-for-key. Placeholders use {name}.

baseline.drift.too_short: You set your style to '{style}', but more than half of recent trades are shorter than expected (median {hold} min). You may be entering impulsively.
baseline.drift.too_long: You're holding longer than your '{style}' style suggests (median {hold} min). Are you delaying your stops?
baseline.drift.consistent: Your actual trades match your declared '{style}' style (consistency {consistency}).
baseline.flag.leverage: You usually trade at {usual}x, but this is {current}x — high leverage by your own standard.
baseline.flag.size: This position is {ratio}x larger than your usual size.
baseline.flag.no_stop: You usually set a stop {coverage} of the time, but there's none here.

assess.guardrail.ruin: Liquidation could wipe out {pct}% of your capital. Regardless of the odds, this exposure alone makes recovery hard.
assess.headline.volatility: Liquidation is close relative to volatility. Give it more room.
assess.coaching.streak_size_strong: You entered at {size}x your usual size right after {streak} losses in a row. Consider pausing.
assess.coaching.streak_mild: Quick re-entry after a losing streak. How about taking a beat?
assess.coaching.size_mild: This is {size}x your usual size. Is that the size you intended?
assess.coaching.freq_mild: You've made {count} trades in 30 minutes. That may be excessive frequency.

journal.insight.technique_vs_execution: {count} trades entered on a sound rationale but lost because you didn't honor the stop. With the same rationale and stop honored, win rate was {win_rate}%. → The problem isn't technique, it's discipline (executing the stop).
journal.insight.discipline_split: Disciplined entries: {d_wr}% win rate (avg {d_pnl}%) vs impulsive entries: {i_wr}% win rate (avg {i_pnl}%). Impulsive trades are eating your account.
journal.insight.worst_emotion: Trades made while '{emotion}' average {avg_pnl}%, your worst. When you feel this way, stopping is the better move.
journal.insight.insufficient: Not enough records yet to find patterns. Keep logging your reviews.

diagnostic.headline.gambling: Right now, neither your technique nor your discipline is in place.
diagnostic.headline.mind_deficient: You have the technique — you just lose by not following it.
diagnostic.headline.technique_deficient: Your mindset is solid, but you have no weapon to swing.
diagnostic.headline.balanced: By self-diagnosis you look balanced. But—
diagnostic.intro: Five quick questions — no data needed yet. This is a tentative read; the real diagnosis comes once you connect your trades.
diagnostic.q.has_edge: I have a setup with a verifiable edge that I trade repeatedly.
diagnostic.q.plan_exit: Before entering, I've decided where I'll exit (target and stop).
diagnostic.q.cut_losses: When price hits my stop, I actually cut the loss.
diagnostic.q.revenge: Right after a loss, I jump back in to win it back.
diagnostic.q.size_control: I keep my position size consistent instead of betting big on conviction.
diagnostic.cta.connect: For the real diagnosis, connect your exchange (read-only).

keys.rejected.title: This key was rejected.
keys.rejected.reason: Read-only keys only. This key still has: {violations}. Remove those permissions (keep only read access) and try again.
keys.unreachable: Couldn't reach the exchange to verify this key. Check the key and try again.
keys.accepted: Key verified as read-only and stored securely.
keys.guidance.title: Before you connect: read this
keys.guidance.why: Jarvis only ever READS your account — it never places, cancels, or modifies orders. But on Binance, the permission needed to read your futures positions cannot be separated from futures trading. So the safest thing you can do is lock this key to our server's IP.
keys.guidance.ip.headline: Restrict this key to an IP address (strongly recommended)
keys.guidance.ip.body: An IP-restricted key only works from the address you whitelist. Even if the key leaked, it would be useless from anywhere else.
keys.guidance.ip.step1: In Binance API Management, open your key and enable "Restrict access to trusted IPs only".
keys.guidance.ip.step2: Add Jarvis's server IP (shown during setup) to the whitelist.
keys.guidance.ip.step3: Leave "Enable Withdrawals" OFF. Jarvis will reject any key that can withdraw.
keys.guidance.ip.not_set: This key is NOT IP-restricted. It works, but we strongly recommend locking it to our server IP — see the setup guide. Withdrawals are blocked regardless.
keys.guidance.advisory_only: Jarvis is advisory only. It analyzes and warns; it never trades for you.

telegram.link.instructions: Open Telegram and send this to the bot to connect alerts: /start {code}
telegram.link.connected: Telegram connected. You'll receive alerts here.
telegram.link.invalid: This link code is invalid or has expired. Generate a new one from the web app.
telegram.start.welcome: Jarvis is connected. I'll warn you the moment your discipline is about to break — grounded in your own trading data.
telegram.start.already_linked: This account is already connected. You're all set.
telegram.warning.coaching.header: ⚠️ Hold on — I'd step back here
telegram.notebook.prompt:
{symbol} {side} closed · {pnl}
One thing — why did you enter? (one tap)
telegram.notebook.saved: Logged: {label}. That tap is the discipline rep.
telegram.daily.no_trades: No trades today. Patience is a position too.
telegram.daily.conclusion.impulse_drag: {count} of today's trades were impulsive entries, and they alone cost {impulse_pnl}. Your disciplined trades came to {disciplined_pnl}. The technique wasn't the problem — the impulse trades were.
telegram.daily.conclusion.clean: No impulsive entries flagged today. This is what discipline looks like.
telegram.daily.conclusion.insufficient: Not enough tagged trades yet to split disciplined vs impulsive. Keep logging.
telegram.weekly.subhead.better: Stronger than last week. Hold the line.
telegram.weekly.subhead.mixed: A mixed week versus last week.
telegram.weekly.conclusion.sl_drop: Stop-loss adherence fell from {prev}% to {curr}%. This isn't technique — it's execution. Your discipline is wavering.
telegram.weekly.conclusion.generic: Compared to last week, the numbers moved. Open the web view for the full picture.

email.magic_link.subject: Your Jarvis sign-in link
